questions.explanation:
## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates multi-region deployment strategies, tenant-aware traffic routing, and production-grade safety controls for an intermediate DevOps engineer role.

## Key Concepts
- Blue/Green deployments across Azure regions
- Azure Front Door per-tenant routing
- Progressive canary rollout by tenant
- Gate enforcement with Azure Policy + OPA
- Drift detection against ARM templates
- Automatic rollback to blue on failure
- Comprehensive logging to Azure Monitor

## Code Example
```yaml
trigger:
  - main

variables:
  blueRegion: 'eastus'
  greenRegion: 'westus2'
  canaryPercentage: 1

stages:
  - stage: PreDeploy_Validation
    jobs:
      - job: PolicyGate
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzurePolicyCheck@0
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
              resourceGroupName: '$(rgName)'
          - task: Bash@3
            name: 'OPAValidation'
            inputs:
              targetType: 'inline'
              script: |
                opa eval --input tenant-config.json --format json --fail-defined-fail data.policies.deny data.policies.warn

  - stage: DeployBlue
    dependsOn: PreDeploy_Validation
    jobs:
      - deployment: DeployToBlueRegion
        environment: 'blue-$(blueRegion)'
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - task: AzureResourceGroupDeployment@3
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
                    resourceGroupName: '$(rgName)-blue'
                    templateLocation: 'Linked artifact'
                    csmFile: '$(Pipeline.Workspace)/templates/api-blue.json'
                - task: AzureCLI@2
                  name: 'RunSmokeTests'
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
                    scriptType: 'bash'
                    scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
                    inlineScript: |
                      az functionapp test run --name api-blue --test-type smoke
                      
  - stage: DeployGreen
    dependsOn: DeployBlue
    jobs:
      - deployment: DeployToGreenRegion
        environment: 'green-$(greenRegion)'
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - task: AzureResourceGroupDeployment@3
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
                    resourceGroupName: '$(rgName)-green'
                    templateLocation: 'Linked artifact'
                    csmFile: '$(Pipeline.Workspace)/templates/api-green.json'
                
  - stage: CanaryRollout
    dependsOn: DeployGreen
    variables:
      tenantList: '$(Pipeline.Workspace)/tenants/tenant-list.json'
    jobs:
      - job: PromoteCanary
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            name: 'RouteCanaryTraffic'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                TENANTS=$(jq -r '.tenants | length * 0.01 | floor' $(tenantList))
                az front door routing-rule update \
                  --frontend-endpoint-name frontend \
                  --name canary-rule \
                  --resource-group $(fdName) \
                  --route-type Performance \
                  --pattern '/*'
                  --backend-pool-name canary-pool
                  
          - task: AzureMonitor@1
            name: 'CheckCanaryMetrics'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
              ResourceGroupName: '$(rgName)'
              alertRules:
                - alertName: 'CanaryErrorRate'
                  condition: 'avg(errorRate) > 5'
                  action: 'fail'
          
  - stage: ProductionPromotion
    dependsOn: CanaryRollout
    condition: succeeded('CanaryRollout')
    jobs:
      - job: UpdateFrontDoorRouting
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            name: 'SwitchTraffic'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az front door routing-rule update \
                  --frontend-endpoint-name frontend \
                  --name production-rule \
                  --resource-group $(fdName) \
                  --backend-pool-name green-pool
                  
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            name: 'DriftCheck'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az deployment group compare \
                  --resource-group $(rgName)-green \
                  --template-file templates/api-green.json
                  
  - stage: Rollback
    dependsOn: ProductionPromotion
    condition: failed()
    jobs:
      - job: RollbackToBlue
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            name: 'RevertTraffic'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az front door routing-rule update \
                  --frontend-endpoint-name frontend \
                  --name production-rule \
                  --resource-group $(fdName) \
                  --backend-pool-name blue-pool
                  
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            name: 'NotifyFailure'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                az monitor alert create \
                  --name pipeline-failure \
                  --resource-group $(rgName) \
                  --description 'Blue/Green deployment failed - rolled back to blue'
```

**Pipeline Flow Summary**

1. **Pre-Deploy Validation** - Azure Policy gate and OPA policy validation before any deployment
2. **Deploy Blue** - Deploy to blue region with smoke tests
3. **Deploy Green** - Deploy to green region for canary testing
4. **Canary Rollout** - Route 1% of tenants to green, monitor metrics
5. **Production Promotion** - Switch Front Door to green, run drift detection
6. **Automatic Rollback** - On failure, revert Front Door to blue and notify

## Why This Is Asked
This question tests PR validation knowledge, per-PR configuration management, secret handling in CI/CD pipelines, container image workflows, and security gates.

## Key Concepts
- PR validation with Azure Pipelines YAML
- Python 3.11 with dependency caching
- Azure Key Vault integration in pipelines
- Azure App Configuration for per-PR settings overrides
- Docker image build and push to ACR
- Health checks and merge gates
- Lightweight security scanning in CI

## Code Example
```yaml
trigger: none
pr:
  branches:
    include:
      - main
  paths:
    include:
      - src/**
      - tests/**
      - Dockerfile
      - azure-pipelines.yml

variables:
  pythonVersion: '3.11'
  dockerRegistryServiceConnection: 'acr-connection'
  imageName: 'fastapi-service'
  imageTag: '$(Build.BuildId)'

stages:
- stage: Validate
  displayName: 'Validate PR'
  jobs:
  - job: Test
    displayName: 'Run Tests'
    pool:
      vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
    steps:
    - task: UsePythonVersion@0
      inputs:
        versionSpec: '$(pythonVersion)'

    - task: Cache@2
      inputs:
        key: 'pip | $(Agent.OS) | requirements.txt'
        path: '$(Pipeline.Workspace)/.pip'
      displayName: 'Cache pip dependencies'

    - script: |
        python -m pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install -r requirements.txt
      displayName: 'Install dependencies'

    - task: AzureKeyVault@2
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: 'azure-service-connection'
        KeyVaultName: 'kv-name'
        SecretsFilter: '*'
        RunAsPreJob: false

    - task: AzureAppConfiguration@1
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: 'azure-service-connection'
        AppConfigurationEndpoint: 'https://appconfig-name.azconfig.io'
        Label: 'pr-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)'
        KeyValueFilters: 'test-*'

    - script: |
        pytest tests/ -v --junitxml=$(Build.StagingDirectory)/test-results.xml
      displayName: 'Run unit tests'
      continueOnError: true

    - publish: $(Build.StagingDirectory)/test-results.xml
      artifact: test-results
      displayName: 'Publish test results'

- stage: BuildAndScan
  displayName: 'Build Image & Scan'
  dependsOn: Validate
  jobs:
  - job: Build
    displayName: 'Build & Push Docker Image'
    pool:
      vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
    steps:
    - task: Docker@2
      displayName: 'Build and push image to ACR'
      inputs:
        containerRegistry: '$(dockerRegistryServiceConnection)'
        repository: '$(imageName)'
        tags: '$(imageTag)'
        command: 'buildAndPush'
        Dockerfile: '$(Build.SourcesDirectory)/Dockerfile'

  - job: HealthCheck
    displayName: 'Health Check Container'
    dependsOn: Build
    pool:
      vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
    steps:
    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Deploy container for testing'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: 'azure-service-connection'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          az container create \
            --resource-group rg-name \
            --name healthcheck-$(Build.BuildId) \
            --image $(dockerRegistryServiceConnection).azurecr.io/$(imageName):$(imageTag) \
            --cpu 1 --memory 1 \
            --ports 8000

          az container wait \
            --resource-group rg-name \
            --name healthcheck-$(Build.BuildId) \
            --condition Running

    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Verify health endpoint'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: 'azure-service-connection'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          sleep 10
          curl -f http://localhost:8000/health || exit 1

    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Cleanup container'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: 'azure-service-connection'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          az container delete \
            --resource-group rg-name \
            --name healthcheck-$(Build.BuildId) \
            --yes

  - job: SecurityScan
    displayName: 'Trivy Security Scan'
    dependsOn: Build
    steps:
    - task: Trivy@0
      inputs:
        scanType: 'fs'
        scanPath: '$(Build.SourcesDirectory)'
        format: 'table'
        severity: 'CRITICAL,HIGH'
        exitCode: '1'
```

## Why This Question Is Asked
This question assesses practical expertise in deploying multi-tenant SaaS applications with per-tenant routing, gated promotions, and automated rollback capabilities.

## Key Concepts
- Azure DevOps YAML pipelines with per-tenant deployment loops
- Blue/Green deployment topology to App Services across separate resource groups
- Front Door integration for per-tenant traffic routing
- Per-tenant feature flags stored in App Configuration or Key Vault
- Environment approvals and policy gates (Azure Policy + Open Policy Agent)
- ARM template drift detection with automatic rollback to the previous green deployment
- Comprehensive telemetry and logging to Azure Monitor

## Code Example
```yaml
# Azure Pipelines YAML for per-tenant blue/green deployments
trigger:
  branches:
    include:
      - main

parameters:
  - name: tenants
    type: object
    default: []

stages:
  - stage: Deploy_Green
    displayName: 'Deploy to Green Environment'
    jobs:
      - job: Deploy_Tenants
        displayName: 'Deploy Each Tenant'
        pool:
          vmImage: 'ubuntu-latest'
        steps:
          - checkout: self
          - task: AzureResourceManagerTemplateDeployment@3
            displayName: 'Deploy ARM Template - Green Slot'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              resourceGroupName: '$(greenResourceGroup)'
              location: '$(location)'
              csmFile: '$(template.green.path)'
              overrideParameters: '-tenantIds ${{ parameters.tenants }}'
          - task: AzureAppServiceManage@0
            displayName: 'Swap Green to Production'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              Action: 'Swap Slots'
              WebAppName: '$(webAppName)'
              SourceSlot: 'green'

  - stage: Approval_Gate
    displayName: 'Environment Approval Gate'
    dependsOn: Deploy_Green
    jobs:
      - job: WaitForApproval
        displayName: 'Await Manager Approval'
        pool: server
        timeoutInMinutes: 1440
        steps:
          - task: ManualValidation@0
            timeoutInMinutes: 1440
            inputs:
              notifyUsers: '$(approvalEmail)'
              instructions: 'Approve production traffic shift for ${{ parameters.tenants }}'

  - stage: Policy_Gate
    displayName: 'Policy Validation Gate'
    dependsOn: Approval_Gate
    jobs:
      - job: AzurePolicy_Check
        displayName: 'Azure Policy Compliance Check'
        steps:
          - task: AzurePolicyCheck@0
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              resourceGroupName: '$(greenResourceGroup)'
              policyAssignment: 'security-baseline-compliance'
      - job: OPA_Check
        displayName: 'OPA Policy Gate'
        container: openpolicyagent/opa:latest
        steps:
          - script: |
              opa eval --bundle ./policies --input ./input.json 'data.tenant.deploy_allowed'
            displayName: 'Validate OPA Policy'

  - stage: Traffic_Shift
    displayName: 'Shift Traffic via Front Door'
    dependsOn: Policy_Gate
    jobs:
      - job: Update_FrontDoor
        displayName: 'Update Front Door Routing'
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: 'Update Front Door Traffic Weights'
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: 'bash'
              scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
              inlineScript: |
                TENANTS='${{ parameters.tenants }}'
                for tenant in $(echo $TENANTS | tr ',' ' '); do
                  flag=$(az appconfig kv show --name $APP_CONFIG_NAME --key tenant/$tenant/traffic-weight --query value -o tsv)
                  az network front-door routing-rule update --resource-group $(frontDoorRG) --front-door-name $(frontDoorName) --name $tenant --backend-pool-name $(backendPoolName) --weight $flag
                done
```

## Why This Is Asked
Tests candidates' ability to design complex, real-world deployments spanning multiple regions, tenants, and policy controls, including traffic management, drift detection, automated rollback, and observability.

## Key Concepts
- Per-tenant namespaces in AKS
- Blue/green rollout strategies across primary and DR clusters
- Argo Rollouts or Istio for traffic shifting
- Azure Policy + OPA gating mechanisms
- Per-tenant feature flags via App Configuration
- Drift checks against ARM templates
- Automated rollback and Azure Monitor Logs integration

## Code Example
```yaml
trigger:
  none

pr: none

resources:
  repositories:
    - repository: templates
      type: git
      name: $(azureDevOpsOrg)/pipeline-templates
      ref: main

variables:
  - group: tenant-config
  - name: aksPrimaryCluster
    value: "aks-primary-weu"
  - name: aksDrCluster
    value: "aks-dr-neu"
  - name: appConfigName
    value: "appconfig-$(env)"

stages:
  - stage: Validate_Templates
    displayName: "Validate ARM Templates"
    jobs:
      - job: Drift_Check
        displayName: "Per-Tenant Drift Detection"
        steps:
          - task: AzureResourceManagerTemplateDeployment@3
            displayName: "Validate ARM Template Syntax"
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              resourceGroupName: $(tenantResourceGroup)
              location: $(location)
              csmFile: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/arm/tenant-template.json
              overrideParameters: "-tenantId $(tenantId)"
              deploymentMode: Validation
          - script: |
              echo "Checking drift against baseline..."
              az resource group show --name $(tenantResourceGroup) \
                --query "properties.templateValidationResults" || true
            displayName: "Detect Configuration Drift"

  - stage: Build_Tenant_Artifacts
    displayName: "Build Container Images"
    jobs:
      - job: Build_and_Push
        displayName: "Build per-Tenant Image"
        steps:
          - task: Docker@2
            displayName: "Build API Image"
            inputs:
              command: build
              dockerfile: $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/Dockerfile
              arguments: |
                --build-arg TENANT_ID=$(tenantId)
                --build-arg BUILD_NUMBER=$(Build.BuildNumber)
              imageName: "$(containerRegistry)/tenant-api-$(tenantId):$(Build.BuildNumber)"
          - task: Docker@2
            displayName: "Push to ACR"
            inputs:
              command: push
              containerRegistry: $(containerRegistry)
              imageName: "$(containerRegistry)/tenant-api-$(tenantId):$(Build.BuildNumber)"

  - stage: Deploy_Primary_Cluster
    displayName: "Deploy to Primary (WEU)"
    dependsOn: [Build_Tenant_Artifacts, Validate_Templates]
    jobs:
      - deployment: Deploy_To_Primary
        displayName: "Deploy with Argo Rollout"
        environment: "aks-primary-$(tenantId)"
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - checkout: self
                - task: KubernetesManifest@0
                  displayName: "Apply Argo Rollout CRD"
                  inputs:
                    action: create
                    kubernetesServiceConnection: $(aksPrimaryConnection)
                    namespace: "tenant-$(tenantId)"
                    manifests: |
                      $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/k8s/rollout.yaml
                - task: AzureCLI@2
                  displayName: "Pause Rollout at 30%"
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    scriptType: bash
                    scriptLocation: inlineScript
                    inlineScript: |
                      kubectl argo rollouts pause tenant-api \
                        -n tenant-$(tenantId) \
                        --kubeconfig $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/kubeconfig
                - task: AzurePolicy@0
                  displayName: "Azure Policy Compliance Check"
                  inputs:
                    azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
                    definitionId: "/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/policyDefinitions/tenant-config-policy"
                    assignmentId: "/subscriptions/$(subId)/resourceGroups/$(tenantResourceGroup)/providers/Microsoft.Authorization/policyAssignments/tenant-policy"
                - bash: |
                    curl -s https://opa-endpoint:8181/v1/data/tenant/promotion \
                      -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
                      -d @/dev/stdin <<< '{"input": {"tenant": "$(tenantId)", "env": "$(env)"}}'
                  name: opa_gate_check
                  displayName: "OPA Policy Gate"

  - stage: Traffic_Shift_30_70
    displayName: "Traffic Shift 30/70"
    dependsOn: Deploy_Primary_Cluster
    condition: succeeded('opa_gate_check')
    jobs:
      - job: Shift_Traffic
        steps:
          - bash: |
              kubectl argo rollouts set-weight tenant-api 30 \
                -n tenant-$(tenantId) \
                --kubeconfig $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/kubeconfig
            displayName: "Set Traffic to 30/70"
          - task: AzureMonitor@1
            displayName: "Monitor Health Metrics"
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              resourceGroup: $(tenantResourceGroup)
              alertRules:
                - alertName: "HighErrorRate"
                  expression: "requests_error_rate > 0.05"
                  severity: warning
          - bash: |
              sleep 300
              echo "Monitoring for 5 minutes before proceeding..."
            displayName: "Smoke Test Period"

  - stage: Traffic_Shift_100
    displayName: "Full Promotion 100%"
    dependsOn: Traffic_Shift_30_70
    jobs:
      - job: Full_Promotion
        steps:
          - bash: |
              kubectl argo rollouts set-weight tenant-api 100 \
                -n tenant-$(tenantId) \
                --kubeconfig $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/kubeconfig
              kubectl argo rollouts promote tenant-api \
                -n tenant-$(tenantId)
            displayName: "Promote to 100% Traffic"

  - stage: Deploy_DR_Cluster
    displayName: "Deploy to DR (NEU)"
    dependsOn: Traffic_Shift_100
    condition: succeeded()
    jobs:
      - deployment: Deploy_To_DR
        displayName: "DR Cluster Sync"
        environment: "aks-dr-$(tenantId)"
        strategy:
          runOnce:
            deploy:
              steps:
                - bash: |
                    kubectl argo rollouts set-weight tenant-api 0 \
                      -n tenant-$(tenantId) \
                      --kubeconfig $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/kubeconfig-dr
                    kubectl apply -f $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/k8s/rollout.yaml \
                      --namespace tenant-$(tenantId) \
                      --kubeconfig $(Build.SourcesDirectory)/kubeconfig-dr
                  displayName: "Initialize DR with Zero Traffic"

  - stage: Auto_Rollback_Check
    displayName: "Rollback Monitoring"
    dependsOn:
      - Traffic_Shift_30_70
      - Traffic_Shift_100
    jobs:
      - job: Monitor_And_Rollback
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: "Configure Rollback Triggers"
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: bash
              inlineScript: |
                az monitor metrics alert create \
                  --name "rollback-$(tenantId)" \
                  --resource-group $(tenantResourceGroup) \
                  --condition "count > 10 where errorCode >= 500" \
                  --action apiUrl=https://v3.rollouts.azrefficient.net/api/rollback \
                    -n "aut rollback-hook"
          - bash: |
              kubectl argo rollouts get rollout tenant-api \
                -n tenant-$(tenantId) -w &
              ROLLOUT_PID=$!
              sleep 600
              if ps -p $ROLLOUT_PID > /dev/null 2>&1; then
                kubectl argo rollouts abort tenant-api \
                  -n tenant-$(tenantId)
                echo "Auto-rollback triggered due to degraded health"
              fi
            displayName: "Health-Based Rollback Monitor"

  - stage: Log_To_Monitor
    displayName: "Azure Monitor Logging"
    dependsOn: [Deploy_Primary_Cluster, Traffic_Shift_30_70, Traffic_Shift_100, Deploy_DR_Cluster]
    jobs:
      - job: Publish_Logs
        steps:
          - task: AzureCLI@2
            displayName: "Send Pipeline Metrics to Log Analytics"
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              scriptType: bash
              inlineScript: |
                az monitor log-analytics query \
                  --workspace $(logAnalyticsWorkspace) \
                  --analytics-query "\
                    PipelineLogs | where PipelineName == '$(PipelineName)' \
                    and TenantId == '$(tenantId)' | summarize \
                    count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Status"
          - task: PublishToAzureMonitorLogs@1
            displayName: "Export Full Pipeline Logs"
            inputs:
              azureSubscription: $(azureServiceConnection)
              ResourceGroup: $(tenantResourceGroup)
              logs:
                - name: TenantDeploymentLogs
                  type: Generic
                  source: pipeline

## Failure Modes and Guardrails

| Failure Mode | Detection | Guardrail |
|--------------|-----------|-----------|
| ARM template drift | Azure Resource Manager validation | Block deployment until reconciled |
| Policy non-compliance | Azure Policy evaluation | OPA gate prevents promotion |
| Traffic shift error rate spike | Log Analytics alert | Auto-rollback via Argo Rollouts |
| DR cluster sync failure | Health endpoint check | Fail deployment, notify via Teams |
| Feature flag mismatch | App Config sync validation | Pause rollout, require manual override |
| Namespace quota exceeded | AKS resource metrics | Pre-deployment quota check |

## Required Integrations

1. **Azure App Configuration**: Store per-tenant feature flags with key vault references for secrets
2. **Azure Container Registry**: Host per-tenant container images with tags
3. **Azure Monitor / Application Insights**: End-to-end observability and alerting
4. **Argo Rollouts**: Kubernetes-native progressive delivery with automated rollback
5. **OPA Gatekeeper**: Policy enforcement for tenant isolation and resource limits
```

```yaml
trigger:

  - stage: Deploy_Dev
```

## Why This Is Asked
Assesses concrete integration of GitOps (ArgoCD) inside Azure DevOps pipelines, ephemeral environments, cost governance, secret management, and observability at scale.

## Key Concepts
- GitOps with ArgoCD in Azure DevOps pipelines
- Ephemeral AKS namespaces per PR
- Secrets from Azure Key Vault per environment
- Feature flags via Azure App Configuration
- Azure Cost Management budgets as gate before deploy
- Post-deployment health checks and synthetic tests
- Automatic teardown on PR close or after grace period
- End-to-end logging in Azure Monitor

## Code Example
```yaml
trigger: none
pr:
  branches:
    include:
    - main

variables:
  - group: 'shared-infrastructure'
  - name: kubernetesNamespace
    value: 'pr-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)'
  - name: gitopsRepo
    value: 'https://github.com/contoso/app-config'
  - name: argoApp
    value: 'pr-$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)'

stages:
- stage: Provision
  displayName: 'Provision Ephemeral Environment'
  jobs:
  - job: CreateNamespace
    displayName: 'Create AKS Namespace'
    steps:
    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Create Kubernetes Namespace'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          az aks get-credentials --resource-group $(resourceGroup) --name $(aksCluster)
          kubectl create namespace $(kubernetesNamespace) --dry-run=client -o yaml | kubectl apply -f -
          kubectl label namespace $(kubernetesNamespace) environment=ephemeral pr-id=$(System.PullRequest.PullRequestId)

- stage: CostGate
  displayName: 'Cost Budget Validation'
  dependsOn: Provision
  condition: succeeded()
  jobs:
  - job: CheckBudget
    displayName: 'Validate Cost Budget'
    steps:
    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Check Cost Management Budget'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          currentSpend=$(az costmanagement query --scope "/subscriptions/$(subscriptionId)" --type "ActualCost" --timeframe "MonthToDate" --query "[0].Amount" -o tsv)
          budgetLimit=$(az consumption budget list --resource-group $(resourceGroup) --query "[0].amount" -o tsv)
          if (( $(echo "$currentSpend >= $budgetLimit" | bc -l) )); then
            echo "Cost budget exceeded: $currentSpend >= $budgetLimit"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "Cost budget check passed: $currentSpend < $budgetLimit"

- stage: Deploy
  displayName: 'Deploy via ArgoCD'
  dependsOn: CostGate
  condition: succeeded()
  jobs:
  - job: ArgoCDDeploy
    displayName: 'Deploy Application'
    steps:
    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Create ArgoCD Application'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          az aks get-credentials --resource-group $(resourceGroup) --name $(aksCluster)
          cat <<EOF | kubectl apply -f -
          apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
          kind: Application
          metadata:
            name: $(argoApp)
            namespace: argocd
          spec:
            project: ephemeral
            source:
              repoURL: $(gitopsRepo)
              targetRevision: HEAD
              path: environments/$(kubernetesNamespace)
              helm:
                values: |
                  namespace: $(kubernetesNamespace)
                  secrets:
                    keyVaultName: $(keyVaultName)
                    secretNames: ["app-db-connection", "app-api-key"]
                  featureFlags:
                    appConfigurationName: $(appConfigurationName)
                    filter: "env=$(kubernetesNamespace)"
            destination:
              server: https://kubernetes.default.svc
              namespace: $(kubernetesNamespace)
            syncPolicy:
              automated:
                prune: true
                selfHeal: true
              syncOptions:
                - CreateNamespace=false
                - PrunePropagationPolicy=foreground
          EOF

    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Wait for ArgoCD Sync'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          az aks get-credentials --resource-group $(resourceGroup) --name $(aksCluster)
          timeout=600
          interval=10
          elapsed=0
          while [ $elapsed -lt $timeout ]; do
            status=$(kubectl get application $(argoApp) -n argocd -o jsonpath='{.status.health.status}')
            if [ "$status" = "Healthy" ]; then
              echo "Application deployed successfully"
              break
            fi
            echo "Waiting for deployment... ($elapsed/$timeout seconds)"
            sleep $interval
            elapsed=$((elapsed + interval))
          done
          if [ $elapsed -ge $timeout ]; then
            echo "Deployment timeout reached"
            exit 1
          fi

- stage: Validate
  displayName: 'Post-Deployment Validation'
  dependsOn: Deploy
  condition: succeeded()
  jobs:
  - job: HealthChecks
    displayName: 'Run Health Checks'
    steps:
    - task: Bash@3
      displayName: 'Application Health Check'
      inputs:
        targetType: 'inline'
        script: |
          echo "Running health checks for $(kubernetesNamespace)..."
          # Add your health check commands here
          # Example: curl -f http://service-url/health

    - job: SyntheticTests
      displayName: 'Run Synthetic Tests'
      dependsOn: HealthChecks
      steps:
      - task: Bash@3
        displayName: 'Execute Synthetic Tests'
        inputs:
          targetType: 'inline'
          script: |
            echo "Running synthetic tests..."
            # Add your synthetic test commands here
            # Example: npm run test:synthetic

- stage: Teardown
  displayName: 'Teardown Environment'
  dependsOn: Validate
  condition: always()
  jobs:
  - job: Cleanup
    displayName: 'Clean Resources'
    timeoutInMinutes: 30
    steps:
    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Remove ArgoCD Application'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          az aks get-credentials --resource-group $(resourceGroup) --name $(aksCluster)
          kubectl delete application $(argoApp) -n argocd --ignore-not-found=true

    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Remove Namespace'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          az aks get-credentials --resource-group $(resourceGroup) --name $(aksCluster)
          kubectl delete namespace $(kubernetesNamespace) --ignore-not-found=true
          echo "Namespace $(kubernetesNamespace) cleaned up successfully"

- stage: AutoTeardown
  displayName: 'Scheduled Teardown (48 hours)'
  condition: and(always(), eq(variables['Build.SourceBranch'], 'refs/heads/main'))
  jobs:
  - job: DelayedCleanup
    displayName: 'Wait and Cleanup'
    timeoutInMinutes: 2880  # 48 hours
    steps:
    - task: AzureCLI@2
      displayName: 'Timeout Cleanup'
      inputs:
        azureSubscription: '$(azureServiceConnection)'
        scriptType: 'bash'
        scriptLocation: 'inlineScript'
        inlineScript: |
          echo "48-hour timeout reached, cleaning up environment"
          az aks get-credentials --resource-group $(resourceGroup) --name $(aksCluster)
          kubectl delete namespace $(kubernetesNamespace) --ignore-not-found=true
          kubectl delete application $(argoApp) -n argocd --ignore-not-found=true
```
